headline: ShinyHunters Claims FBI Hack, Says It's Not Financial
summary: The ShinyHunters hacking group claims it breached the FBI and stole data on employees and applicants, according to The Register, TechCrunch, Bleeping Computer and Engadget. Bleeping Computer says the group used an Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day, and The Register and Engadget report the group says the breach is not financially motivated.
